title: Tumour vascularization via endothelial differentiation of glioblastoma stem-like cells
central_claims: A substantial portion of glioblastoma vascular endothelium can derive from neoplastic stem-like cells.
Selective elimination of GSC-derived endothelial vessels reduces tumor growth.

source_manifest.title: Experiments from unfinished Registered Reports in the Reproducibility Project: Cancer Biology
source_manifest.finding: Tie2 expression experiment agreed in direction; endothelial-cell-targeting xenograft experiment remained incomplete.

source_manifest.title: Transdifferentiation of glioblastoma cells into vascular endothelial cells
source_manifest.finding: Independent mouse/human models showed tumor-derived endothelial cells; formation persisted under VEGF inhibition.

source_manifest.title: Glioblastoma stem cells generate vascular pericytes to support vessel function and tumor growth
source_manifest.finding: Lineage-tracing established GSC-derived pericytes and anti-tumor effect of their elimination; alternative vascular lineage complicates endothelial generalization.
